    customers = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    d = instance["distance_matrix"]
    nn = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", None)

    all_nodes = list(customers)
    if not all_nodes:
        return []

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_internal_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        s = 0
        prev = route[0]
        for k in range(1, len(route)):
            nxt = route[k]
            s += d[prev][nxt]
            prev = nxt
        return s

    def route_full_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        return d[depot][route[0]] + route_internal_cost(route) + d[route[-1]][depot]

    def try_two_opt(route):
        # deterministic first-improvement 2-opt
        n = len(route)

            return False

        improved = False

            b = route[i + 1]

                    return True
